Harper: Quick tiny-game: one 3	60s song + one short print/zine or single-issue comic recommendation. Keep it pocket-sized.
Zoe: I'll go: Song - 'Love Is All - Make Out, Make Up' (2:46). Zine - 'Flora & Smalltown' (local photocopied comic, 20 pages).
Devon: Nice. Mine: Song - 'The Velvet Underground - Pale Blue Eyes' (3:42). Zine - 'Noise & Static' (experimental essays, perfect for a coffee break).
Samir: For a mood flip: Song - 'The Dears - Easy' (3:58). Zine - 'Pocket Weirds' (short surreal comic, tiny run).
Harper: Also, office swap note: shelf-bot will do a tidy on Friday 6 donate unclaimed zines to community table.
shelf-bot: Reminder: Drop zines for swap by Thu 5pm or they'll be moved to free-shelf.
Zoe: Anyone want to compile these into a micro-playlist + pdf index? I can slap together a 6-track playlist and a one-page index.
Devon: Yes please. Put me down for scanning one zine.
Samir: Voting: react :one: for indie/nostalgia, :two: for upbeat, :three: for experimental. I'll tally live tomorrow.
Harper: Love the energy. If people bring physical things, label them with name + "swap" so shelf-bot doesn't archive them early. :label:
